description: Header file defining the DisplayInfo class, which implements plugin, web, and JSONRPC interfaces for display information management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes nested Notification class for connection property notifications, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, information retrieval, and event handling.

classes.name: DisplayInfo
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing display information interface, web interface, and JSONRPC for WPEFramework.

classes.name: DisplayInfo::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling connection property notifications, managing registration and updates.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and returns responses.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Updated
methods.description: Triggers the event indicating display info has been updated.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::event_updated
methods.description: Handles the display info update event.

methods.name: DisplayInfo::Info
methods.description: Fills display info data structure with current info.
